input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is the APPROVED COVENANT CREATURE SOURCE, the authority for anatomy, palette and painting style. Use BOTH references visually. Match its lighter stylized painted values and simple sculpted shapes exactly; do not darken into realistic horror, add photoreal skin or fur, or add black shadows. Reference-1 is an A10 master or a crop of that approved source. Generate the requested anatomical view even if the reference is a rear view. This is an ANIMAL ONLY. No human body, no clothes, no weapon or staff, no hands. Keep its exact creature anatomy. Raw magical low lean canine made of charcoal-black cracked stone hide, ember seams, angular pointed ears, long jointed legs, compact flame tail. Four legs and distinct lean hound muzzle; no gore. FRONT-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally TOWARD viewer and image RIGHT, face and front surfaces clearly visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly THREE columns by TWO rows, SIX complete sequential poses of the same creature. Row 1: 1 ready animal stance; 2 legs fold and chest lowers; 3 belly and chest very low. Row 2: 4 creature tips gently onto its side; 5 head, chest and belly touch the ground; 6 fully still LYING FLAT ON ITS SIDE, head resting on ground, legs relaxed. Keep its intact animal anatomy, no human posture or equipment. The final body lies on the ground, never standing, crouching or sitting. Non-graphic creature collapsing and lying on the ground, no gore, no blood, no injury detail. Each complete creature occupies only HALF its spacious cell, with all tail, horns, antennae and wings inside wide empty gutters. Each equal cell contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 60% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only.

arguments.Prompt:
Stylized digital hand-painted character animation sprite sheet of a Cinder Hound creature collapse animation, presented on a solid, flat, uniform vivid MAGENTA background (#FF00FF).

Grid layout: Exactly 3 columns by 2 rows (a 3x2 grid of 6 equal cells), with wide empty magenta margins and gutters between cells. No borders, frames, grid lines, panel boxes, ground planes, floors, or text/labels anywhere.

Perspective and Camera: Elevated 55-degree isometric/orthographic perspective, camera looking down from high angle. In all 6 frames, the creature is seen from a front-right three-quarter view (head and torso facing diagonally forward toward the viewer and toward the image right, so its face and front chest are clearly visible).

Creature anatomy & visual design (matching reference-1.png and reference-2.png):
A lean magical hound / canine beast sculpted from charcoal-black cracked stone hide with glowing ember seams and volcanic fissures running between plates. Long jointed quadruped legs, angular pointed ears, a sleek predatory hound muzzle, and a compact flickering flame tail. Pure quadruped animal anatomy (no humanoid posture, no weapons, no armor, no clothes, no gore or blood).

Sequential collapse animation stages (3 columns x 2 rows = 6 poses):
Row 1:
- Cell 1 (top-left): Ready animal stance, standing alert on all four legs, front-right 3/4 view.
- Cell 2 (top-middle): First stage of collapsing - legs begin folding, knees buckling, chest lowering toward the floor.
- Cell 3 (top-right): Second stage of collapse - all four legs folded, belly and chest held very low just above the ground.
Row 2:
- Cell 4 (bottom-left): Creature losing balance and gently tipping over onto its right flank/side.
- Cell 5 (bottom-middle): Head, chest, and body touching the ground as it settles down on its side.
- Cell 6 (bottom-right): Completely collapsed and still, lying flat on its side on the ground with head resting on the floor and legs limp and relaxed in repose. Intact body, peaceful defeated slump, no gore.

Composition and Scale:
Every pose is at the exact same anatomical scale, occupying only about 50-60% of its spacious cell, leaving generous empty vivid magenta gutters around each body. Entire creature including tail, snout, and paws is completely contained within each cell, never cropped, cut off, or crossing any border.

Painting Style:
Hand-painted digital dark fantasy game concept art with sculpted painterly volumes, lighter stylized painted values, broken confident contours, smooth opaque brushwork, subtle silver and warm ember edge highlights, cool upper-left directional lighting, and small minimal contact shadows beneath the paws/body. Absolutely clean uniform #FF00FF magenta background.
